Name: Drawberry's Seasonal Cute Characters for Eli and Dylan
Author: drawberry138
Description:
[b][u]I do NOT consent to my work being used to train AI or used in AI generation.[/u][/b]

[size=3][b][u]This is a SPRITE mod, NOT a portrait mod. 
[/u][/b]
I put my Aseprite down for 48 hours after I finished my East Scarp mod and then immediately went to start a new one… 
I’m so excited to share this with you guys - TenebrousNova has put so much effort and love into Eli and Dylan and it really shows!

﻿This mod [b]REQUIRES [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿,[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883] Eli and Dylan[/url]﻿, Content Patcher, and SMAPI. 
﻿I [b]RECOMMEND[/b] you download Poltergeister's[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450] Vanilla SC[/url][/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]C[/url]﻿,[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045] East Scarp SCC[/url]﻿, and my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43012]East Scarp Remastered SCC[/url]﻿ for a unified look!
﻿
[b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]download the mod[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]drag it into your mods folder and unzip![/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][b]﻿Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][size=3]configurable noses[/size][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][size=3]seasonal cute sprites for Eli and Dylan[/size][/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][b]
All my mods are uploaded with permission from the original mod creators. [/b][/size]
[size=3][b]
If you'd like, you can buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/drawberry138]here[/url]![/b][/size]
[size=3]
I really hope you enjoy my work! Much love and take care,

Drawberry xo

[b]Special thanks to:[/b][/size]
